name: sundials
description: SUNDIALS (SUite of Nonlinear and DIfferential/ALgebraic equation Solvers). Overlay of the stock vcpkg port adding an optional `kokkos` feature that builds the Kokkos N_Vector (SUNDIALS::nveckokkos) for the OpenSWMM Phase 1 OpenMP GPU plugin.

kokkos.description: Build the Kokkos N_Vector (SUNDIALS::nveckokkos) against the kokkos overlay port. Required by the openswmm_gpu_omp plugin backend.

openmp.description: Build the OpenMP N_Vector (SUNDIALS::nvecopenmp) via ENABLE_OPENMP. Threads the SUNDIALS vector ops so the core (non-plugin) CPU solver gets OpenMP parallelism without the Kokkos plugin. OpenMP comes from the compiler / Homebrew libomp; no extra vcpkg dependency.
